title: alnus glutinosa f. tenuifolia
intro: Alnus glutinosa f. tenuifolia, commonly known as the narrow-leaved alder, is a subspecies of the alder tree that is native to Europe. This plant is valued for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The narrow-leaved alder is also used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, and its antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Alnus glutinosa f. tenuifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
